[[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Lanu Pasiq]] wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:Inquisitortraining.jpg|left|thumb|Lanu Pasiq training with the other Inquisitors.]]
Lanu Pasiq wielded the lightsaber in a training session with fellow Inquisitors [[Antinnis Tremayne]], [[Halmere]], and [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]], while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] supervised the session. Inquisitor Tremayne very quickly overwhelmed her and the other Inquisitors by disarming them of their lightsabers and wielding all four blades at once.<ref name="EAR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]'' {{1st}}
